completion_data.completion_summary: Added multi-task argument support to /orchestrate with dependency-aware wave dispatch: updated orchestrate.md with STAGE 0 multi-task parsing, batch validation, Kahn's algorithm wave assignment, and parallel wave execution; added Section 13 to multi-task-operations.md documenting wave dispatch rationale and comparison table; updated CLAUDE.md command table and multi-task syntax paragraph.

memory_candidates.content: Wave-based dispatch pattern for /orchestrate multi-task: use Kahn's algorithm on intra-batch dependencies from state.json to assign tasks to topological waves. Tasks within each wave execute in parallel via concurrent Skill tool calls to skill-orchestrate; waves execute sequentially. Failed tasks block direct dependents in later waves but not sibling tasks in the same wave. Batch session ID format: sess_{timestamp}_{random}_{task_num} per task.
